MashStepType.description: MashStepType - a per step representation occurring during the mash.

type.description: What the step does to the mash.

amount.description: The volume of water added in this step. Applies to infusion steps.

step_temperature.description: The temperature the mash is held at during the step.

step_time.description: How long the mash is held at the step temperature.

ramp_time.description: The amount of time  that passes before this step begins. eg moving from a mash step (step 1) of 148F, to a new temperature step of 156F (step 2) may take 8 minutes to heat the mash. Step 2 would have a ramp time of 8 minutes.

end_temperature.description: The temperature the mash is expected to have fallen to by the end of the step.

description.description: Free text description of the mash step.

water_grain_ratio.description: Also known as the mash thickness. eg 1.75 qt/lb or 3.65 L/kg.

infuse_temperature.description: Temperature of the water for an infusion step.

start_ph.description: The pH of the mash at the start of the step.

end_ph.description: The pH of the mash at the end of the step.
